name: app-dark-cosmic-mood-check-in-with-flower-orb
title: Starfield AI check-in with a glowing flower, slider and long dimmed-and-bright case-study text
whatItIs: A black case-study page with tiny caps labels, a big paragraph where sentences alternate white and grey, and a phone with a starry background, greeting, chips, a glowing iridescent flower above 'How do you feel right now?', a pastel slider and a 'Talk to me' voice field.
whatItMeans: Meditative and intimate; the flower stands in for emotion.
techniques: Use a glowing organic object as an emotion indicator.
Keep the phone small in a vast black page.
Use a single slider for mood.

vocabulary.definition: A symbolic visual reflecting the user's state.
Alternating text brightness to guide reading.
A slider from unpleasant to pleasant.
A prompt bar with a mic icon.
